summary: Review B (security) of Phase S2 at 882f068 found two blocking defects in the spec-review gate. First, validate_spec_review_payload checks only the first line of a finding, so a [Blocker] finding after a line break in nonblocking_findings passes with status pass. Second, the scope rule strips each path, so a committed file ' measure/runs/x' outside measure/runs/ passes. The --baseline handling is safe: every option-like value and every range fails closed before git diff, and no output file is created. The role file permissions are identical to Review A. The tests write only in temporary folders.
security_applicability_reason: test-strategy.md Phase S2 says 'Review B (security): applicable, full scope.' The diff ccdaae2..882f068 adds a new agent permission block (agents/measure-spec-review.md) and a new gate branch that passes a user-supplied --baseline value to git (skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py).
blocking_findings: skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:82,356: SPEC_REVIEW_FINDING_RE has no end anchor, and the validator calls re.match. Python '.' does not match a line feed, so only the first line must have the format. A live probe with nonblocking_findings ['F1 [Major] x: y\nF2 [Blocker] z: real blocker'] and status pass gave exit 0 and 'PASS: spec-review gate passed'. The same result occurs with '\r' and with U+2028 as the separator. This breaks the spec Decision 17 rule 'only [Major] or [Nit] findings in nonblocking_findings', and a track can start Red with a Blocker. Recommendation for Green: mark a finding invalid when len(finding.splitlines()) != 1, and use SPEC_REVIEW_FINDING_RE.fullmatch. Add a test case for each of the three separators.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:642: the scope rule applies item.strip() to each path of 'git diff --name-only'. A committed file ' measure/runs/x' (a top-level folder whose name starts with a space) is outside measure/runs/, but the strip makes it 'measure/runs/x', and the gate passed (exit 0) in a live probe. With the host setting core.quotePath=false, a path that starts with U+3000 also passed. The impact is limited to new paths with a leading whitespace name, but the gate passes when the contract says it must fail. Recommendation for Green: run 'git diff --name-only --no-renames -z <baseline>..HEAD', split the output on NUL, and do not strip. This also removes the dependence on core.quotePath. Add a test case for ' measure/runs/x'.
nonblocking_findings: skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:632-636: the gate does not check that --baseline is an ancestor of HEAD. In live probes, an orphan commit with the same tree as HEAD passed, and '--baseline HEAD' passed after an earlier out-of-scope commit. The orchestrator supplies the value, so this is a misuse risk, not an injection. The strategy lists 'HEAD with no new commit' as a good form. Recommendation: add 'git merge-base --is-ancestor <baseline> HEAD' as a fail-closed check.

agents/measure-spec-review.md:13-39 (identical to agents/measure-review-a-correctness.md, older than this track): the bash block allows '*' and denies by substring. 'git -c k=v commit' does not contain the substring 'git commit', and 'python3 -c' can write a file without the '>' character. The committed-file scope rule catches a commit. An uncommitted edit of spec.md or plan.md is not caught; a live probe of an uncommitted edit gave exit 0, which spec Decision 17 defines as the contract. Recommendation: have the orchestrator compare 'git status --porcelain' before and after the role, or add a working-tree check to the spec-review gate.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:636-642: a valid file below measure/runs/ with a non-ASCII name or a line feed in the name fails the gate, because git quotes the path ('"measure/runs/demo_track/\303\274.txt"'). The gate fails closed, and the strategy marks this 'Report'. The '-z' fix of blocking finding 2 also fixes this false fail. A related message defect: for the committed path ' src/app.py', the failure line names 'src/app.py', which is a different path.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:642: a committed symbolic link 'measure/runs/link' with the target '../../src' passed the gate. The link changes no file outside measure/runs/, so the scope rule is correct. A later tool that writes through the link can write outside measure/runs/. Recommendation: document the case, or reject a symbolic link below measure/runs/ in the spec-review gate.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:346: paraphrase.proposes '\u200b' (zero-width space) passed, because str.strip() keeps U+200B. The strategy marks this 'Report'. Recommendation: require at least one character for which str.isalnum() is true.
